name: kickoff-handover-canonical-agents-2026-05-10
description: Schema-v2 dispatcher for the 2026-05-10 canonical-agents handover refresh. Spawns one Cursor agent per ecosystem workspace (10 projects); checks idempotency phase-by-phase (emission vs deploy); enforces a pre-flight gate (disk free, SSH keys, human_setup_required, git remote); pins each project's audited deploy_command; supports a --direct-deploy mode that bypasses the agent layer and runs the audited script directly with built-in production verification. Refactored 2026-05-10 after the tanastok deploy lesson — see LESSONS.md.
